lead_headline: Zero new restaurant leads after Friday's pair, subscriptions flat at net 0, foreclosure filings hit 65 but highest barely cracks $2.7M

restaurant.blurb: No new leads today — first zero-lead day since mid-week. Active tracker holds at 163 openings, 144 closures from yesterday's Tacos Samy/Bad Ass Coffee additions.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications for second consecutive day — unprecedented back-to-back shutout extends post-backlog normalization. No status changes, no removals detected. Week closes at 8 total applications vs. prior week's 152, confirming 95% collapse and return to sustainable baseline after June's clearance anomaly. Post-surge pattern now clear: sporadic single-digit weekly volume replacing triple-digit backlog-driven activity.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention today — LeBron/Caldwell-Pope Sixers coverage on Facebook rounds out quiet Saturday. Week closes at 81 mentions across 15 sources, up 21% from prior week's 67 and extending two-week growth streak. Instagram dominates at 35 citations (43% share), Reddit 12, Denver Post 10, Facebook 9. Week's storylines: RiNo closures (sauna, butcher shop evictions), Westminster Mall nostalgia, FBI e-bike retailer seizures, Zoo AI ads controversy. Daily rate 11.6 vs. prior period's 9.6 marks sustained uptick in third-party pickup as summer civic/business stories gain traction.

subscriptions.blurb: Net 0 yesterday (1 new, 1 canceled) — balanced churn follows Friday's +2 uptick but acquisition falls back to single-digit weakness. MTD bleeds deeper to −30 (−1.2/day) as July erosion accelerates. 90-day net holds at +81 but shrinking fast. Two-day pattern (Friday +2, Saturday 0) hints at stabilization attempt after mid-month's −14 single-day collapse, but 1-new acquisition rate matches June lows and signals demand fragility. Cancellations controlled at 1 but new subscriber pipeline remains anemic. YTD +196 (+1.0/day) intact but July's −1.9/day drag now three weeks running.
